title: NASA to Cover 35th SpaceX Resupply Mission Space Station Departure
description: NASA and its international partners are set to receive scientific research samples and hardware as a SpaceX Dragon spacecraft departs the International Space Station no earlier than Wednesday, Nov. 18, for its return to Earth.
